daily.today_energy: The cosmos is giving you that quiet confidence energy today. There's a gentle magnetism around you—people are drawn to your authenticity. Lean into it and let your vibe do the talking without forcing anything.

daily.career: Your intuition is sharper than usual—trust those gut feelings about projects or people. This isn't the day to play small. Your ideas have weight, so speak up with intention and watch how people actually listen.
daily.health: Your body's asking for grounding right now. Whether it's a walk, some stretching, or just putting your phone down for an hour—honor that need. Mental clarity follows when you take care of the physical stuff.

weekly.career: Your ideas are magnetic this week. Don't sleep on that project or conversation you've been hesitating about. Your intuition about direction is spot-on, and putting yourself out there professionally opens unexpected doors.
